department: Department of Computing (UKRI CDT in AI for Healthcare)

deadline.value: 2027-entry deadlines are not posted yet. In the 2026 cycle, Round 1 closed 22 Feb 2026, Round 2 on 30 Apr 2026, and overseas applications closed 30 June 2026; there is no guarantee that funding or places remain after Round 1.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the 2026 application cycle will be as follows: | 22 Feb 2026 (Round 1) | Applications from overseas candidates will close on 30 June 2026. | Unfortunately, there is no guarantee that any funding or places will remain available after Round 1 of applications.

supervisor.value: You do not need to contact a supervisor or write a research proposal. Shortlisted applicants rank the available projects, and the supervisor teams interview and match them.
supervisor.quote: no specific research proposal is required and you do not need to contact a potential supervisor

funding.value: UKRI AI4Health studentships pay Home-rate tuition and a UKRI stipend (GBP 23,805 in 2026-27). Only a very limited number of highly competitive scholarships cover the extra overseas fee, so Indian applicants should look for other funding too.
funding.quote: The studentship covers the Home-rate tuition fees (£5238 per annum in 2026-27) and a bursary at the standard UKRI rate | Please note that in order to fund the difference between home and international tuition fees, a very limited number of scholarships for international students may be available. However, these are highly competitive, and we strongly encourage applicants with overseas tuition fees status to explore additional funding opportunities.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to have a First Class 4-year bachelor's degree and a Distinction master's (or equivalent) in computer science, engineering, maths, physics, statistics, biology or medicine.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have or to achieve a First Class (4-year) Undergraduate degree and Distinction level Master’s degree or equivalent degrees in a relevant scientific or technical discipline

toefl_min.value: The programme requires Imperial's Standard English level: TOEFL iBT 92 overall (min 20 in each section), or 4.5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: our programme requires that students have proficiency at Standard level

ielts_min.value: The programme requires Imperial's Standard English level: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (min 6.0 in each element).
ielts_min.quote: our programme requires that students have proficiency at Standard level

notes: A 4-year PhD; apply to 'AI and Machine Learning' (PhD 4YFT) on Imperial's portal. It is open to overseas applicants. The process includes admissions tests, a panel interview and project matching, and the programme needs ATAS clearance. Contact: ai4health-admissions@imperial.ac.uk.
name: UKRI CDT in AI for Healthcare (AI and Machine Learning PhD)
